units.source_text: 有一个晚上雾下的很大，隔着一个插满冬蔷薇的花瓶，我坐在对面听嘎尔漫谈。

en.t: One evening, when the fog was very thick, I sat across from Gael and listened to him chatter, with a vase full of winter roses between us.

units.source_text: 我记得那是一个分离派风格的房间，整个房间包括桌椅都是白色镶细金边的。

en.t: I remember that it was a Secession-style room, and everything in it, including the table and chairs, was white with thin gold trim.

units.source_text: 嘎尔比平时还要志得意满，笑容满面地谈着执政党——Quorax党内阁。

en.t: Gael was even more self-satisfied than usual, smiling broadly as he talked about the ruling party, the Quorax Party cabinet.

units.source_text: “喀拉克斯”只是个没有实际意义的感叹词，只能翻译成“哎呀”。

en.t: Quorax was only an interjection with no real meaning, and could only be translated as something like oh dear.

units.source_text: 总而言之，这是声称着永远优先为“全体河童谋福利”的政党。

en.t: In short, it was a political party that claimed it would always put first the welfare of all kappa.
